WITH emp_loc AS (
    SELECT e."Ssn", e."Salary",
           MIN(dl."Dlocation") AS "location"
    FROM "employee" e
    JOIN "dept_locations" dl ON e."Dno" = dl."Dnumber"
    GROUP BY e."Ssn", e."Salary"
),
loc_agg AS (
    SELECT "location",
           COUNT(*) AS "loc_emp_cnt",
           AVG("Salary") AS "loc_avg_salary"
    FROM emp_loc
    GROUP BY "location"
),
loc_retention AS (
    SELECT la."location",
           la."loc_emp_cnt",
           SUM(CASE WHEN e."Salary" > la."loc_avg_salary" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "loc_above_avg_cnt"
    FROM emp_loc e
    JOIN loc_agg la ON e."location" = la."location"
    GROUP BY la."location", la."loc_emp_cnt", la."loc_avg_salary"
)
SELECT SUM(lr."loc_above_avg_cnt") * 1.0 / SUM(lr."loc_emp_cnt") AS "retention_probability"
FROM loc_retention lr;
